claims.title: FeMoCo ground-state energy resource estimate via spectral amplification and DFTHC (Low et al., 2025)
claims.headline: FeMoCo's ground-state energy could be estimated with about 3.2 million physical qubits in roughly 2.7 hours.

claims.title: RSA-2048 factoring resource estimate with windowed arithmetic, coset representation, and oblivious carry runways (Gidney and Ekerå, 2021)
claims.headline: A 2048-bit RSA integer could be factored in about 8 hours with about 20 million noisy qubits.
